brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full with cover:0,0,0;full;top (lid) and cover:0,0,0;full;bottom forms enclosed hex cell usable as storage box. check_build meshClash clear.

Top cover lid (cover:0,0,0;full;top) has magnets enabled via setCoverMagnets on=true, verified by configurator accepting the operation without NO_CHANGE after toggle test. Bottom cover also magnet-enabled for consistency.

finish.summary: Single-cell Hex storage box: one full base at 0,0,0 with top and bottom full covers enclosing volume. Top lid magnetized via setCoverMagnets to hold shut. Build passes checks with meshClash clear.
